en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.687 - As for the other side (of Mosque of Quba),

"That is the location of the tent of the hypocrites. When they saw him (the Prophet) raising his hand, some of them said to one another,
'Look at his eyes; they are turning as if he were a madman.'
Then Archangel Jibril (as) descended with this verse: 'Indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message and they say, "He is indeed mad." But it is nothing except a reminder to the worlds.' (Surah Al-Qalam, 68:51-52)"
Al-Sadiq (as) narrated this incident to Hassan al-Jammal when he accompanied him from Madinah to Makkah.
Imam (as) said to him: "O’ Hassan, if you were not my camel driver, I would not have narrated this story to you."
